nodes.title: RIP-Seq
nodes.scope: Illumina explanatory schematic and the distinct native PRC2 RIP-seq implementation supported by its cited Zhao et al. primary paper (PMID 21172659). The drawing shows one linear route: RNA-protein complex → immunoprecipitation → RNase digestion → RNA extraction → reverse transcription → cDNA. The disconnected far-left RNA immunoprecipitation (RIP) icon is an overview, without a transfer arrow into the chain. No branches, end-group labels, barcodes, legend or library-adaptor structures are shown. The primary-supported native route is recorded separately, without the schematic RNase-trimming step; these two graph components distinguish evidence scopes rather than depict an experimental branch. Sequencing/library interfaces supplied by the paper are explicitly confined to the native implementation. Separate UV-crosslink RIP/RT-qPCR validation in that paper is not the sequenced-library route.
